Evangelicalism is a christian group in America which follows [[Neo-Calvinism]]

It is quite vicious and virulent and poisoned by [[ur-fascism]] but at the same time it has some unique traits.

In analysis over whether it's a [[technoreligion]] it demonstrates significantly more technoreligous traits than one would expect. 

== Categorization ==

=== Pseudo-religious ideology traits ===
* High political involvement
* embracing technology

=== Semi-Axial traits ===
* some emphasis on spirituality at least higher than things like Communism

=== Arguments against it as a technoreligion ===
* plays too defensive{{Efn|This is hard for atheists to understand as they have no concept of a religion playing hardball/offense. 

Playing offense would mean inserting itself into public discourse with the intention of gaining converts who were not already associated with them. Mainly converting atheists}}
* Incompetent with recent generations{{efn|more an argument against it succeeding than it being a technoreligion}}

== Possible futures ==
Due to the technoreligion characteristics of Evangelicalism it may have a potential to have leaders emerge in it which will become highly powerful and influential. 

=== Advantages ===
Lots of wealth and political power

Surprisingly good media competence which has been the case for decades

* this only applies to social media if you count [[Trump grifters]].

Religious

=== Challenges ===

* A leader needs to be both a highly political "grifter" and promote a spiritual system. These tend not to go in common well
* Evangelicalism is too defensively oriented and unconcerned with legitimate proselytism to atheists. It sometimes does a performative proselytism, but it cannot seem to comprehend the worldview of atheists enough to perform genuine proselytism.
* Evangelical''ism is arguably mostly discredited across the world. Many people who are more than willing to listen to Lifeism may not be willing to listen to Evangelicalism''
* The Evangelical population is too concerned with maintaining material influence over politics and maintaining privilege over evangelism{{Efn|Ironic for the name}}. Maintaining privilege is not something that convinces people to your side. 
** The biggest irony is if they focused on gaining privilege they actually would have a case for potential converts. 

* They use [[queerphobia]] as a motivator for their members. This makes them miss out on a major demographic for religious conversion and costs them public sympathy
* Their spiritual offerings are questionable. Many people treat them just as a political movement

== Future ethnoreligion? ==
It is quite possible Evangelicalism will transform into an ethnoreligion much like Judaism. Assuming their political defeat, which seems inevitable they may be left without a state and as a relatively despised group with high ingroup solidarity. The highly competitive internal environment may make Evangelicalism formalize itself into an insular religion like Rabbinical Judaism much like what happened to the Pharisees.
